title.value: “Your child needs surgery”: A survey-based evaluation of simulated expert consent conversations by key stakeholders
title.justification: The title is provided at the beginning of the document and clearly describes the paper's focus on evaluating consent conversations in pediatric surgery.
title.quote: “Your child needs surgery”: A survey-based evaluation of simulated expert consent conversations by key stakeholders

extractions.description: The paper explores the practice of expert consenting in pediatric surgery from the perspective of key stakeholders, including families and healthcare professionals. It analyzes recorded consent sessions involving senior pediatric surgeons and standardizes patient feedback through questionnaires to identify strengths and areas for improvement. The study highlights the importance of effective communication and patient engagement to improve the consent process, aiming to develop an educational resource for this purpose.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on medical practices related to pediatric surgery and the informed consent process, rather than climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Consent conversations in pediatric surgery are essential components of pre-operative care which, when inadequate, can lead to significant adverse consequences for the child, parents, surgeon, and others in the healthcare system.
